newsitem.title: USA: AgriBioTech Inc CEO purchased shares.
newsitem.headline: AgriBioTech Inc CEO purchased shares.

text.p: AgriBioTech Inc Tuesday said Johnny Thomas, president and chief executive, purchased 200,000 shares at $7.50 per share and 223,500 shares at $3 per share.
In addition, unaffiliated parties purchased an aggregate of 176,500 shares through the exercise of stock options at $3 per share.

The company received an aggregate of $2.7 million cash from the early exercise of these options and warrants, including $2,170,500 from Thomas. The company also announced that it has purchased a seed cleaning plant in Tulia, Texas, from Mycogen for $525,000.
AgriBioTech is a fully integrated full service seed company specializing in the forage and turf seed sector.
